problem_type: Agent storyboard defaults ignore available character image inputs
symptom: Eight video shots can persist text-only modes despite real referenced character images
direct_cause: propose_storyboard_plan saves parsed modes before advisory validation; referenceBindings are not derived from real anchor URLs
class_root: Missing joint mode and real-reference binding invariant at the AI draft write boundary
affected_population: Agent storyboard drafts with referenced visual character image URLs across catalog vendors
entry_points: Native lane nomi_storyboard_write through shared renderer application
internal_only_reason: Existing model profiles own external contracts; this repair changes only internal AI draft default admission, not a provider API or dependency.
invariants: A referenced real character image gets a consuming mode and bound slot before an AI draft is saved whenever the selected catalog model can accept it
Explicit GUI modes and old project hydration are not rewritten
Unsupported models retain honest inline warnings; insufficient capacity never silently discards references
generality_proof: Both lane and capability callers converge on propose_storyboard_plan in applyCanvasToolCall; the catalog-supplied vendor identity and existing slot declarations determine admission without provider branches.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Joint catalog mode selection and real character image binding before AI draft persistence
A real image bound in the active image slot satisfies its anchor dependency; unbound anchors still wait.

same_class_entry_points.evidence: All native and capability draft writes converge here after schema parsing and before setStoryboardPlan.
User-authored mode edits are explicit intent and retain #681 advisory; hydration likewise never passes draft normalization.
Targeted user-requested field edits are not default full-draft planning; existing reference bindings are preserved.
Production single-shot planner returns the same normalized AI draft IR before materialization; original response text retained as evidence.

recurrence.reason: Every model-written draft can omit slots or choose a text mode regardless of available real images.
same_class_scan: rg propose_storyboard_plan src electron: shared applyCanvasToolCall admission
rg referenceBindings src/workbench: schema, slot append and meta projection
rg setStoryboardPlan src/workbench: GUI, proposal, patch and hydration examined

prevention.invariant: Real referenced character images and consumable modes are admitted together for AI drafts.
prevention.failure_mode: Reject insufficient slot capacity or missing catalog identity; models without image capability retain visible ignored-reference warning.
prevention.strategy: Normalize before persistence using existing catalog and slot append owner, not prompt text or generation-time corrections.

legacy_paths.rationale: Replaces unconditional raw AI draft persistence for the real-anchor population; no second write route remains.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: An internal admission invariant using already installed catalog, schema and slot owners; no runtime upgrade needed.

migration: No implicit legacy migration: existing saved user mode choices stay intact; newly planned drafts are normalized using existing PlanShot fields.
residual_risks: Reference input consumption is not a guarantee of generated face consistency; this task generates no media.
